facts.fact: StackAdapt's Creative Strategist who wrote the post says her transition from Production Designer to Creative Strategist lasted almost two months.
facts.quote: The whole transition lasted almost two months.

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt, the Creative Strategy team meets twice a week, either for creative coffee sessions or team huddles.
facts.quote: We meet up twice a week for either creative coffee, or team huddles.

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt, its Creative Strategists build campaign creative assets including HTML5 banners, native ads, and video ads.
facts.quote: Creative Strategists build the creative assets for campaigns. This includes HTML5 banners, native ads, or video ads.

facts.fact: StackAdapt holds a creative kick-off call with clients to gather campaign goals and pain points before developing a creative strategy.
facts.quote: Before we come up with a strategy or concept, we hop on a creative kick-off call with our clients.
